description: This file is a PHP source file implementing a Smarty plugin modifier called debug_print_var, which formats variables for display in the Smarty templating engine's debug output.

methods.name: smarty_modifier_debug_print_var
methods.description: Formats a variable's contents for display, handling various data types including arrays, objects, booleans, NULL, resources, integers, floats, and strings. It recursively processes nested variables and escapes output for safe display.
